Plot MST traces

Source: R/plot.R
mst_plot_traces.Rd

Draws one line per capillary. Requires ggplot2.

Usage

mst_plot_traces(data, colour = ligand_concentration)

Arguments

data

A data frame of traces, as returned by read_mst_traces().

colour

<data-masking> The column to colour lines by. Numeric columns are coloured on a log scale.

Value

A ggplot.

Examples

traces <- read_mst_traces(tidymst_example("dppr10-cy5_traces.xlsx"))
mst_plot_traces(traces)
